verses.original: הָ֭אֵלֶּה שְׁלֹ֤שֶׁת הָאֲנָשִׁ֣ים וַֽיִּשְׁבְּת֡וּ מֵעֲנ֣וֹת אֶת־ אִיּ֑וֹב כִּ֤י ה֖וּא צַדִּ֣יק בְּעֵינָֽיו׃פ
verses.transliteration: hā·’êl·leh šə·lō·šeṯ hā·’ă·nā·šîm way·yiš·bə·ṯū mê·‘ă·nō·wṯ ’eṯ- ’î·yō·wḇ kî hū ṣad·dîq bə·‘ê·nāw
verses.literal: So these three men stopped answering - Job because he was righteous in his own eyes

verses.original: וַיִּ֤חַר אַ֨ף׀ אֱלִיה֣וּא בֶן־ בַּרַכְאֵ֣ל הַבּוּזִי֮ מִמִּשְׁפַּ֪חַ֫ת רָ֥ם חָרָ֣ה אַפּ֑וֹ בְּ֭אִיּוֹב עַֽל־ צַדְּק֥וֹ נַ֝פְשׁ֗וֹ מֵאֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yi·ḥar ’ap̄ ’ĕ·lî·hū ḇen- ba·raḵ·’êl hab·bū·zî mim·miš·pa·ḥaṯ rām ḥā·rāh ’ap·pōw bə·’î·yō·wḇ ‘al- ṣad·də·qōw nap̄·šōw mê·’ĕ·lō·hîm
verses.literal: This kindled the anger of Elihu son of Barachel the Buzite of the family of Ram He burned with anger against Job for justifying himself rather than God

verses.original: חָרָ֪ה אַ֫פּ֥וֹ וּבִשְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת רֵעָיו֮ עַ֤ל אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹא־ מָצְא֣וּ מַעֲנֶ֑ה וַ֝יַּרְשִׁ֗יעוּ אֶת־ אִיּֽוֹב׃
verses.transliteration: ḥā·rāh ’ap·pōw ū·ḇiš·lō·šeṯ rê·‘āw ‘al ’ă·šer lō- mā·ṣə·’ū ma·‘ă·neh way·yar·šî·‘ū ’eṯ- ’î·yō·wḇ
verses.literal: and he burned with anger against [Job’s] three friends because - they had failed . . . to refute [Job] and yet had condemned - him

verses.original: וֶֽאֱלִיה֗וּ חִכָּ֣ה אֶת־ בִּדְבָרִ֑ים אִ֭יּוֹב כִּ֤י הֵ֖מָּה זְֽקֵנִים־ מִמֶּ֣נּוּ לְיָמִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: we·’ĕ·lî·hū ḥik·kāh ’eṯ- biḏ·ḇā·rîm ’î·yō·wḇ kî hêm·māh zə·qê·nîm- mim·men·nū lə·yā·mîm
verses.literal: Now Elihu had waited - to speak to Job because the others were older than he -

verses.original: אֱלִיה֗וּא וַיַּ֤רְא כִּ֘י שְׁלֹ֥שֶׁת הָאֲנָשִׁ֗ים אֵ֤ין מַעֲנֶ֗ה בְּ֭פִי אַפּֽוֹ׃פ וַיִּ֥חַר
verses.transliteration: ’ĕ·lî·hū way·yar kî šə·lō·šeṯ hā·’ă·nā·šîm ’ên ma·‘ă·neh bə·p̄î ’ap·pōw way·yi·ḥar
verses.literal: But when he saw that the three men had no further reply . . . his anger was kindled

verses.original: אֱלִיה֖וּא בֶן־ בַּֽרַכְאֵ֥ל הַבּוּזִ֗י וַיֹּ֫אמַ֥ר וַיַּ֤עַן׀ אֲנִ֣י צָ֘עִ֤יר לְ֭יָמִים וְאַתֶּ֣ם יְשִׁישִׁ֑ים עַל־ כֵּ֖ן זָחַ֥לְתִּי וָֽאִירָ֓א׀ מֵחַוֺּ֖ת דֵּעִ֣י אֶתְכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ’ĕ·lî·hū ḇen- ba·raḵ·’êl hab·bū·zî way·yō·mar way·ya·‘an ’ă·nî ṣā·‘îr lə·yā·mîm wə·’at·tem yə·šî·šîm ‘al- kên zā·ḥal·tî wå̄·ʾī·rå̄ mê·ḥaw·wōṯ dê·‘î ’eṯ·ḵem
verses.literal: So Elihu son of Barachel the Buzite . . . declared I am young in years while you are old that is why . . . I was timid and afraid to tell you what I know -

verses.original: אָ֭מַרְתִּי יָמִ֣ים יְדַבֵּ֑רוּ וְרֹ֥ב שָׁ֝נִ֗ים יֹדִ֥יעוּ חָכְמָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ’ā·mar·tî yā·mîm yə·ḏab·bê·rū wə·rōḇ šā·nîm yō·ḏî·‘ū ḥāḵ·māh
verses.literal: I thought that age should speak and many years should teach wisdom

verses.original: אָ֭כֵן הִ֣יא רֽוּחַ־ בֶאֱנ֑וֹשׁ וְנִשְׁמַ֖ת שַׁדַּ֣י תְּבִינֵֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ’ā·ḵên hî rū·aḥ- ḇe·’ĕ·nō·wōš wə·niš·maṯ šad·day tə·ḇî·nêm
verses.literal: But [there is] a spirit in a man the breath of the Almighty that gives him understanding

verses.original: לֹֽא־ רַבִּ֥ים יֶחְכָּ֑מוּ וּ֝זְקֵנִ֗ים יָבִ֥ינוּ מִשְׁפָּֽט׃
verses.transliteration: lō- rab·bîm yeḥ·kā·mū ū·zə·qê·nîm yā·ḇî·nū miš·pāṭ
verses.literal: It is not only the old who are wise or the elderly who understand justice

verses.original: לָכֵ֣ן אָ֭מַרְתִּי שִׁמְעָה־ לִּ֑י אָֽנִי׃ אַף־ אֲחַוֶּ֖ה דֵּעִ֣י
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên ’ā·mar·tî šim·‘āh- lî ’ā·nî ’ap̄- ’ă·ḥaw·weh dê·‘î
verses.literal: Therefore I say Listen to me I too will declare what I know

verses.original: הֵ֤ן הוֹחַ֨לְתִּי לְֽדִבְרֵיכֶ֗ם אָ֭זִין עַד־ תְּב֥וּנֹֽתֵיכֶ֑ם עַֽד־ תַּחְקְר֥וּן מִלִּֽין׃
verses.transliteration: hên hō·w·ḥal·tî lə·ḏiḇ·rê·ḵem ’ā·zîn ‘aḏ- tə·ḇū·nō·ṯê·ḵem ‘aḏ- taḥ·qə·rūn mil·lîn
verses.literal: Indeed I waited while you spoke I listened to your reasoning as you searched for words

verses.original: אֶתְבּ֫וֹנָ֥ן וְהִנֵּ֤ה וְעָֽדֵיכֶ֗ם אֵ֣ין לְאִיּ֣וֹב מוֹכִ֑יחַ מִכֶּֽם׃ עוֹנֶ֖ה אֲמָרָ֣יו
verses.transliteration: ’eṯ·bō·w·nān wə·hin·nêh wə·‘ā·ḏê·ḵem ’ên lə·’î·yō·wḇ mō·w·ḵî·aḥ mik·kem ‘ō·w·neh ’ă·mā·rāw
verses.literal: I paid you full attention . . . . . . But no one proved Job wrong not one of you rebutted his arguments

verses.original: פֶּן־ תֹּ֣֭אמְרוּ מָצָ֣אנוּ חָכְמָ֑ה אֵ֖ל לֹא־ אִֽישׁ׃ יִדְּפֶ֣נּוּ
verses.transliteration: pen- tō·mə·rū mā·ṣā·nū ḥāḵ·māh ’êl lō- ’îš yid·də·p̄en·nū
verses.literal: So do not claim We have found wisdom let God not man refute him

verses.original: וְלֹא־ עָרַ֣ךְ מִלִּ֑ין אֵלַ֣י לֹ֣א אֲשִׁיבֶֽנּוּ׃ וּ֝בְאִמְרֵיכֶ֗ם
verses.transliteration: wə·lō- ‘ā·raḵ mil·lîn ’ê·lay lō ’ă·šî·ḇen·nū ū·ḇə·’im·rê·ḵem
verses.literal: But Job has not directed [his] words against me and I will not answer him with your arguments

verses.original: חַ֭תּוּ לֹא־ ע֑וֹד עָ֣נוּ מִלִּֽים׃ הֶעְתִּ֖יקוּ מֵהֶ֣ם
verses.transliteration: ḥat·tū lō- ‘ō·wḏ ‘ā·nū mil·lîm he‘·tî·qū mê·hem
verses.literal: [Job’s friends] are dismayed with no more to say words have escaped them

verses.original: וְ֭הוֹחַלְתִּי כִּי־ לֹ֣א יְדַבֵּ֑רוּ כִּ֥י עָ֝מְד֗וּ לֹא־ עֽוֹד׃ עָ֥נוּ
verses.transliteration: wə·hō·w·ḥal·tî kî- lō yə·ḏab·bê·rū kî ‘ā·mə·ḏū lō- ‘ō·wḏ ‘ā·nū
verses.literal: Must I wait now that they are silent . . . now that they stand and no longer reply

verses.original: אֲנִ֣י חֶלְקִ֑י אַף־ אַעֲנֶ֣ה אַף־ אָֽנִי׃ אֲחַוֶּ֖ה דֵעִ֣י
verses.transliteration: ’ă·nî ḥel·qî ’ap̄- ’a·‘ă·neh ’ap̄- ’ā·nî ’ă·ḥaw·weh ḏê·‘î
verses.literal: I . . . too will answer yes I will declare what I know

verses.original: כִּ֭י מָלֵ֣תִי מִלִּ֑ים ר֣וּחַ בִּטְנִֽי׃ הֱ֝צִיקַ֗תְנִי
verses.transliteration: kî mā·lê·ṯî mil·lîm rū·aḥ biṭ·nî hĕ·ṣî·qaṯ·nî
verses.literal: For I am full of words and my spirit within me compels me

verses.original: הִנֵּֽה־ בִטְנִ֗י לֹא־ יִפָּתֵ֑חַ כְּיַ֥יִן יִבָּקֵֽעַ׃ חֲ֝דָשִׁ֗ים כְּאֹב֥וֹת
verses.transliteration: hin·nêh- ḇiṭ·nî lō- yip·pā·ṯê·aḥ kə·ya·yin yib·bā·qê·a‘ ḥă·ḏā·šîm kə·’ō·ḇō·wṯ
verses.literal: Behold my belly vvv is like unvented wine it is about to burst like a new wineskin

verses.original: אֲדַבְּרָ֥ה וְיִֽרְוַֽח־ לִ֑י אֶפְתַּ֖ח שְׂפָתַ֣י וְאֶֽעֱנֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·ḏab·bə·rāh wə·yir·waḥ- lî ’ep̄·taḥ śə·p̄ā·ṯay wə·’e·‘ĕ·neh
verses.literal: I must speak and find relief I must open my lips and respond

verses.original: אֶשָּׂ֣א פְנֵי־ אַל־ נָ֭א אִ֑ישׁ וְאֶל־ לֹ֣א אֲכַנֶּֽה׃ אָ֝דָ֗ם
verses.transliteration: ’eś·śā p̄ə·nê- ’al- nā ’îš wə·’el- lō ’ă·ḵan·neh ’ā·ḏām
verses.literal: I will be partial . . . to no . . . one . . . nor will I flatter any man

verses.original: כִּ֤י לֹ֣א יָדַ֣עְתִּי אֲכַנֶּ֑ה עֹשֵֽׂנִי׃ יִשָּׂאֵ֥נִי כִּ֝מְעַ֗ט
verses.transliteration: kî lō yā·ḏa‘·tî ’ă·ḵan·neh ‘ō·śê·nî yiś·śā·’ê·nî kim·‘aṭ
verses.literal: For I do not know how to flatter or my Maker would remove me in an instant
